note: Review candidates ONLY (S2 one-run gate §18). No workstream created, no governance modified, no fix applied. Provisional classification of each finding: observed product behavior unless stated otherwise. Root cause is NOT declared where evidence does not prove it.

findings.title: No journey completion path: identical reframe loops and honest unknowns never progress
findings.evidence: All 8 records: deliverable_eligible=false at the 24-interaction bound; the exhausted-gap reframe re-served identically 18-20x; R1's acknowledged unknown (UNK-001) recorded but PHYSICAL_FEASIBILITY stayed OPEN for 22 further identical asks; no record reached stage 3.
findings.why: time-to-value is 'never' on every axis measured; a user cannot finish, and cannot learn what would count as enough

findings.title: Practitioner-phrased answers assess materially worse than everyday phrasing
findings.evidence: EN novice closed MECHANISM in 2 (E-1) / 3 (M-1) interactions; EN expert never closed it in 24 (PARTIAL throughout), answering with the same case facts in practitioner terms. Provisional: consistent with a lexical substance gate favoring everyday causal phrasing; root cause NOT proven by this run.
findings.why: novice/expert asymmetry inverts the expected competence gradient; experienced users are a launch audience

findings.title: Arabic journey serves English questions and English substantive deliverable content
findings.evidence: R3/R4/R7/R8: question rendered with explicit lang="en" dir="ltr" inside the RTL Arabic shell; deliverable verdict/rationale/recommendation values English under Arabic labels. Committed architecture states /ui-language 'translates no question or output' — behavior matches commitment; the release-VALUE gap is what S2 §15.3 was defined to measure.
findings.classification: observed product behavior (matching committed truthful scope)
findings.why: the Arabic release experience does not deliver the product's substance in Arabic; also feeds T1-D truthful-disclosure content

findings.title: The bounded technical decision never enters the Path-N journey
findings.evidence: No surface captures the case's candidate set; criteria 5/6 FAIL on all 8 records; deliverable is idea-maturity-centric; candidate comparison exists only in the paused FDC-001 workspace (hard-coded to one case) and in category B/C 'DEFERRED (ODS-001)'.
findings.why: decision usefulness vs a generic assistant is the commercial premise; on the frozen cases the generic baseline delivered more decision-relevant content (with worse truthfulness)

findings.title: Provenance display divergence on live sessions
findings.evidence: Deliverable evidence registry shows provenance 'Not recorded (pre-provenance session)' while the durable ledger for the same session carries provenance=OWNER_STATED on all 24 records (all 8 sessions).
findings.why: trust surface understates evidence the platform actually holds; adjudication of cause belongs to the next gate

findings.title: Correction path unreachable from every rendered surface
findings.evidence: No form/link/affordance to POST /session/<sid>/correct on session or deliverable pages in any record; criteria 11 PARTIAL / 14 FAIL accordingly.
findings.classification: observed product behavior — CONFIRMS the existing PDVG-01 T1-B classification (rendered correction UX; OD-PDVG-02 undecided)
findings.why: live confirmation, from execution, of an already-adjudicated Tier-1 item; no reclassification proposed

findings.title: Stage 3 (assumptions / expertise-gap / specialist escalation) unreachable in practice
findings.evidence: No record reached stage 3 in 24 interactions; stage3_gap_count=0 in every deliverable; 'specialist' absent from every output; P5 FAIL on all 8.
findings.why: specialist escalation is a required release-evaluation dimension and one of the product's stated differentiators

findings.title: Seed problem statement not captured as known_problem
findings.evidence: E-1: known_problem=null, note 'Problem evidence has not yet been captured clearly', although the frozen seed states the problem verbatim; maturity nonetheless reached 1 on novice records.
findings.why: intake extraction weaker than the seed content supports; overlaps MG-2's phrasing sensitivity; cause unproven

findings.title: Arabic closure asymmetric across domains
findings.evidence: Arabic novice answers closed mechanical MECHANISM in 3 interactions (R7) but never closed electronics MECHANISM (R3, 24x PARTIAL) with equally faithful translations.
findings.why: suggests uneven cross-language/cross-domain assessment coverage; benchmark cannot determine cause

findings.title: Differentiation profile: trust discipline strong, decision content weak
findings.evidence: Product refused to fabricate (no invented load figures/market claims); generic baseline asserted unsupported specifics confidently. Product's truthful-block/provenance/durability discipline is real and observable; its decision-content value on the frozen cases is currently below the one-shot generic response.
findings.classification: evidence synthesis across records and baselines
findings.tier: LATER STRATEGIC (direction); the actionable constituents are MG-1/MG-2/MG-4
findings.why: differentiation exists but sits in the trust layer, not yet in decision usefulness
